name: Maestro Blaster V1.1
author: stewart1234
description: Stealth-learn music notation as you blast oncoming alien ships! Discover common patterns for playing chord shapes. Focus on a particular 'Key Signature' ( - that's a scale! ) or play through all 12 key signatures to complete the game. Suitable for all ages comfortable to blast alien ships. Please log any bugs in the comments and I will update accordingly. Happy Blasting!
